structural_check.kind: Known-model discrimination using multivariate dependence only
structural_check.noise_pairing: Each sigma uses the same latent states and standard measurement noise for each source/seed pair.
structural_check.observations: Fresh independent DAG state and independent Gaussian measurement noise for every observation.
structural_check.measurement_noise: Independent noise on each of C,G,M; sigma is standard deviation.
structural_check.classifier: Equal prior probabilities; cumulative joint Gaussian log density under fixed known candidates; no parameter estimation, adaptation, forgetting or social pooling.
structural_check.matching: Both joint means are zero. Incumbent G residual variance is .5448 instead of .5; all other residuals and all edges match the revised main model. Observable univariate variances are [.5,.8648,.8648] for both candidates before measurement noise.
structural_check.conditional_covariance_caveat: The [0,.16] result conditions on true C; conditioning on a noisy measurement need not remove the incumbent dependence.
structural_check.confusion_convention: Rows generating candidate, columns predicted candidate; posterior ties within absolute tolerance 1e-10 contribute one half to each column; probabilities divide counts by number of seeds.
structural_check.analytic_kl_convention: Entry [noise,source] is KL(source observable joint density || other candidate), nats per fresh observation.
interpretation_limits: This establishes distinguishability only within the supplied two-model menu at the tested coefficients and noise levels.
Dependence differs through coefficients and their signs as well as graph structure; this is not an ablation isolating topology.
Distinct latent causal models may share these observable densities; no unique causal graph identification is claimed.
The adaptive social engine is not run in this check and does not receive these fresh DAG samples in the main experiments.
The main persistent-signal experiments retain unequal means and are not converted into structure-recovery tests by this supplemental check.
